Hackers :: CVS

All BE300 specific and/or modified files are in our local cvs server, available for anonymous access.

Quickguide:
Login into CVS tree:
cvs -d:pserver:anonymous@cvs.linux4.be:/cvsroot login
Press "Return" when prompted for password. You only need to do this once on any machine.
Check out a copy of the tree:
cvs -z3 -d:pserver:anonymous@cvs.linux4.be:/cvsroot co linux/kernel

Our goal is NOT to fork, but to provide a flexible working environment where we can share our 'work in progress'. Once files are more or less stable, we'll get them into the Linux-MIPS CVS Tree on Sourceforge.

Alternatively, you can browse the CVS tree online
